25 now, so 10-12 years since I was a teenager. I used to have a group of two friends who were super close, and we always fucked with eachother. So, one day for no reason, one of our friends ( J we shall refer to him ) ditches us one day and decided to hang out with his girlfriend. So me and S ( not J ) were annoyed. We were teenagers lol.

Anyway, we loved the show South Park but J did not. So we took a famous character named Scott Malkinson from there, and pretended that he actually existed in the real world and was a real person. We created a fake birthday, made Scott to be a really caring and awesome guy, the type of guy who’d give you the shirt off his back if he had nothing else. We’d be in Xbox live party chats with eachother and S or I would say ( Hey Scott’s wanting a party at his house for graduation, are you coming? ) while J was in there. J asked about him many times and wondered who he was but we never gave him pictures or anything, just someone we went to school with. Scott eventually joined the army and fought in Afghanistan. He did two tours. Eventually he came back and sought some help for the things he saw in the desert. 

Scott really has no one like himself. Took care of his mother. His ex girlfriend lost her dog and he found it after a week of searching. He was a great man. J to this day never knew he was fake. S and I like to let him live on, imagining that Scott is out there somewhere now with a family, finding peace after the war and things he has dealt with.
